name: Jinhan
events: King Pasa becomes ruler of the Korean kingdom of Silla.
Jobun becomes king of the Korean kingdom of Silla.
Cheomhae becomes king of the Korean kingdom of Silla.
Michu of Silla ascends to the Korean throne of Silla, becoming the first ruler of the Long Kim line.
Yurye becomes king of the Korean kingdom of Silla.
Girim becomes the king of the Korean kingdom of Silla.
Haelhae becomes the king of the Korean kingdom of Silla.
Naemul becomes king of the Silla dynasty (Three Kingdoms of Korea).
